svg.title: Runtime comparison on external MiniWoB tasks
svg.desc: The historical October 13 campaign is a different artifact and does not prove capability preservation for this runtime change. The new comparison uses the frozen initial Umbra binary and final candidate, unchanged upstream BrowserGym setup/validation, 125 task types, five original seeded repeats, ten interaction requests, forty observations and a 120-second episode cap. Every frozen episode remains in the denominator. Both arms use the same filtered Umbra MCP surface and model configuration. Arm order is deterministically shuffled per task/repeat.
